title: Le Creuset  5.5 qt dutch oven
text: Le Creuset  5.5 qt dutch oven. Le Creuset 5.5 qt dutch oven - purchased as a gift for my daughter - she collects the Indigo color.  As you would expect, Le Creuset is a good, heirloom purchase.  With care, they will last your cooking life.  They are heavy (cast iron) - my daughter has a gas stove and so the cast iron is a perfect choice. Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Le Creuset Enameled Cast Iron Signature Sauteuse Oven, 3.5 qt., Cerise
features: This versatile size is perfect for soups, casseroles and one-pot meals
The wide base is great for browning meats on the stovetop before slow braising or roasting in the oven and sloped sides facilitate stirring
Colorful exterior enamel is shock-resistant to prevent chipping and cracking
Sand-colored interior enamel has a smooth finish that promotes caramelization, prevents sticking and resists stains
Dome-shaped lid locks in flavor by promoting continuous circulation of heat and moisture
description: The Le Creuset Sauteuse is indispensable in the kitchens of home cooks and professional chefs alike. Long recognized for its strength and durability, cast iron is the prime material for slow-cooking, braising and roasting, thanks to its ability to maintain even and consistent heat. The enameled oven needs no seasoning, and it’s suitable for both stovetop and oven use.

details.Product Care Instructions: Oven Safe, Stove Safe, Dishwasher Safe
